text:
Compound M contains calcium.
Two reactions of M are listed.
●
M reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to form a salt and water only.
●
M reacts with aqueous ammonium chloride to form a gas that turns damp red litmus
paper blue.
What is M?
A
CaOH
B
Ca(OH)2
C
CaCO3
D
Ca(CO3)2
subject: Chemistry
